name: App Forum
about: A collaborative platform for app developers at UIU. We discuss mobile and web application development, share project ideas, organize hackathons, and help each other build real-world skills.

name: UIU Computer Club
about: The largest and most prestigious club at UIU. UIU Computer Club (UIUCC) drives innovation through programming contests, seminars, and tech workshops. We nurture future software engineers and tech leaders.

name: Cultural Club
about: The Cultural Club of UIU celebrates the rich heritage and diversity of Bangladeshi culture. We organize music, drama, dance, and poetry events that enrich campus life and foster creativity.

recentPosts.author: Tamim Al Mitul
recentPosts.content: Registrations for the Autumn Cultural Fest drama competition are now OPEN! Sign up before October 1st.

name: Robotics Club
about: The UIU Robotics Lab is where hardware meets software. We build autonomous robots, IoT devices, and embedded systems. Members compete in national and international robotics competitions.

recentPosts.author: Molla Nabil Basar
recentPosts.content: New 3D Printers arrived! Three brand-new Bambu Lab machines are now in the lab. Orientation this Friday.

recentPosts.author: Mahmudul Hasan Emon
recentPosts.content: Our team placed 2nd in the National RoboFest 2024! Super proud of everyone who put in the work!

name: UIU Debate Club
about: UIU Debate Club (UIUDC) is dedicated to promoting logic, critical thinking, public speaking, and parliamentary debate skills among students. We represent UIU in national and international debate tournaments.

recentPosts.author: Samiha Anjum
recentPosts.content: The registration for the upcoming Inter University National Debate Competition is now open. Team formation meetings at Room 402.

name: Sports Club
about: UIU Sports Club brings together athletes and sports enthusiasts across campus. We organize tournaments, foster teamwork, and promote fitness through indoor and outdoor sports activities.
